critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in WizardBaixa.js: Step 1 validation was blocking navigation when user wanted to skip file upload and fill data manually. Changed canProceed() case 1 to return true.
seed_data_creation: Created test baixa processes during testing (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baixa wizard is fully functional. The fix applied to WizardBaixa.js allows users to skip step 1 (file upload) and proceed to manual data entry. All 6 steps work correctly: 1) Upload contrato (optional), 2) Dados da empresa, 3) Qualificação dos sócios, 4) Motivo da baixa, 5) Patrimônio e responsabilidades, 6) Distrato gerado com downloads. Backend endpoints /api/baixa/extrair-contrato and /api/baixa/gerar-distrato are working with AI integration.
